messages:
mika: Quick sync — customer Southbridge is greenlit for a Private/VPC deploy in their prod VPC. Proposed quiet window: Wed 03:00–04:30 UTC. Who can own ops + smoke and who wants rollback responsibility? Need DB migration guardrails.

jordan: I can take ops lead and orchestrate the slot.

priya: I’ll own smoke tests. planning to run the usual suite + embeddings sanity. Will need the service-account creds staged in vault.

anton: I’ll be rollback lead. Quick question: is there a DB migration? if so we need a backup snapshot pinned before the start.

mika: There is a small migration: alter on customer_embeddings (add `embedding_version` int default 1). No heavy backfill. Anton — agreed, snapshot + schema rollback script.

priya: Smoke checklist draft: 1) health endpoints for all inference pods 2) sample generation end-to-end 3) embedding vector length check 4) latency spike monitor 5) logistic health dashboard check. I’ll paste commands 15m before start.

lucas: Heads up — we have a feature flag toggle for `southbridge_new_routing` that will be rolled with the deploy. We should canary it to 10% for 15m then ramp. If rollout fails, flip back.

jordan: Ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood/sops/southbridge-deploy (permissions open to team). I’ll coordinate maintenance window in PagerDuty and set the quiet channel.

mika: Can we keep a smoke window of 20m after deploy to validate production traffic? Priya — ok?

priya: Yep — plan: run smoke harness then hit these commands:
```
./tools/smoke.sh --env=southbridge --suite=prod-smoke --samples=20
kubectl get pods -n southbridge -o wide
curl -sS https://southbridge-api.internal/health | jq .
```
Will post pass/fail and attach logs.

deploy-bot: Reminder — create deploy ticket with `deploy-bot create` and add approvers.

mika: Code review status: PR #4821 (routing + feature flag) needs one more review from infra (Anton?), and PR #4830 (migration) is approved by Priya but needs integration test. Please ping reviewers 30m before.

anton: I’ll review #4821 now. If anything blocks, I’ll raise a hold.

jordan: I'll schedule the quiet channel and set the maintenance note in the console. Also will run the preflight: `./scripts/preflight.sh southbridge` at -30m and paste output here.

mika: Rollback plan (short): 1) flip `southbridge_new_routing` to off 2) redeploy previous image tag 3) restore DB snapshot if migration failed to revert column add. Anton to run step 3 if needed.

priya: Monitoring hooks: I will watch the latency dashboard and the error-rate alert. If >2x baseline or >=1% 5m error rate, call rollback.

lucas: Reminder: notify customer CSM 24h and again 1h prior. I’ll send the 24h notice.

mika: Final asks: everyone acknowledge in-thread if you’re available Wed 03:00–05:00 UTC. If any blockers, flag now.

jordan: ack available.

priya: ack available.

anton: ack available.

lucas: ack available.

samantha: will be on-call backup if needed — ack.

mika: Perfect — I’ll lock the window and post the deploy checklist in the runbook. Pinging again 1h before with exact handoff. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: D-98721. Add comments with preflight output and approvals.
